title: SPECTRA: Revealing the Full Spectrum of User Preferences via Distributional LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2509.24189v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often represent user preferences by generating ranked item lists. These lists can overrepresent frequent categories and omit long-tail interests. We instead treat preference prediction as an LLM classification task, where a fine-tuned LLM assigns a probability to each category. Given a user's interaction history, we estimate the share of future interactions in each category. We propose SPECTRA (Softmax Probing for Extracted Category-level Token Readouts and Analysis), which reads a distribution over interpretable preference categories from a fine-tuned LLM's token scores. We evaluate SPECTRA on MovieLens, Yelp, and a large-scale short-video platform. SPECTRA delivers (i) distributional alignment, reducing Jensen-Shannon divergence to the empirical preference distribution by 38--44% across public datasets; (ii) long-tail recovery with cross-user fairness, raising top-3 category exposure entropy by $23%$ on

translated_title: SPECTRA：通过大语言模型分布式推理揭示用户偏好的全谱系
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通常通过生成排序后的项目列表来表示用户偏好。这些列表可能过度代表高频类别，而忽略长尾兴趣。我们转而将偏好预测视为LLM分类任务，即由微调后的LLM为每个类别分配一个概率。给定用户的交互历史，我们估计未来交互在每个类别中的占比。我们提出SPECTRA（基于Softmax探测的类别级token读数提取与分析方法），该方法从微调后LLM的token分数中读取可解释偏好类别上的一个分布。我们在MovieLens、Yelp以及一个大规模短视频平台上对SPECTRA进行了评估。SPECTRA实现了：(i) 分布对齐，在公开数据集上将与经验偏好分布的Jensen-Shannon散度降低了38-44%；(ii) 具备跨用户公平性的长尾恢复，将top-3类别曝光熵提升了23%...
tldr: SPECTRA将用户偏好预测从生成排序列表转变为让微调后的LLM输出各偏好类别的概率分布，显著提升了分布对齐效果、长尾兴趣恢复能力和跨用户公平性。
en_tdlr: SPECTRA reframes preference prediction from generating ranked lists to having a fine-tuned LLM output a full probability distribution over interpretable preference categories, substantially improving distributional alignment, long-tail interest recovery, and cross-user fairness.
